name: Weapon Adept
summary: A weapon-focused ascetic who perfects a chosen Monk weapon, controls initiative, and culminates in pure physical and mental power.

features.name: Perfect Strike
features.summary: Gain Perfect Strike without meeting its prerequisites; at 10th level roll three attack dice and keep the highest.

features.name: Way of the Weapon Master (Weapon Focus)
features.summary: Gain Weapon Focus with one Monk weapon without meeting prerequisites.

features.name: Way of the Weapon Master (Weapon Specialization)
features.summary: Gain Weapon Specialization with the same Monk weapon without meeting prerequisites.

features.name: Evasion
features.summary: Gain Evasion at 9th level instead of Improved Evasion.

features.name: Uncanny Initiative
features.summary: Choose any result from 1 to 20 instead of rolling initiative.
